title: Polaris Key shared enums (conformance/parity/enums.json)
description: Closed vocabularies every SDK spells identically (README §3.1). Hand-written; tools/gen-sdk-constants.ts validates it against this schema and generates one constant group per enum in every SDK. An enum is added here when its owner defines it.

name.description: The enum's name, lowerCamelCase. The generated group is its PascalCase form (`platform` → `Platform`).
